select m.message_id, m.item_id, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, fu.user_name as from_user_name, fu.avatar as from_user_avatar, tu.user_name as to_user_name, tu.avatar as to_user_avatar, i.title as item_title from message m left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.user_id left join user tu on m.to_user_id = tu.user_id left join item i on m.item_id = i.item_id
and fu.user_name like concat('%', #{message.fromUserName}, '%')
and tu.user_name like concat('%', #{message.toUserName}, '%')
and m.content like concat('%', #{message.content}, '%')
and m.is_read = #{message.isRead}
and m.item_id = #{message.itemId}
order by m.create_time desc

select m.message_id, m.item_id, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, fu.user_name as from_user_name, fu.avatar as from_user_avatar, tu.user_name as to_user_name, tu.avatar as to_user_avatar, i.title as item_title from message m left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.user_id left join user tu on m.to_user_id = tu.user_id left join item i on m.item_id = i.item_id where m.message_id = #{messageId}

select m.message_id, m.item_id, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, fu.user_name as from_user_name, fu.avatar as from_user_avatar, tu.user_name as to_user_name, tu.avatar as to_user_avatar, i.title as item_title, latest.msg_count as message_count, (select count(*) from message x where x.item_id = m.item_id and least(x.from_user_id, x.to_user_id) = least(m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id) and greatest(x.from_user_id, x.to_user_id) = greatest(m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id) and x.is_read = 0) as unread_count from message m join ( select max(message_id) as max_id, count(*) as msg_count from message group by item_id, least(from_user_id, to_user_id), greatest(from_user_id, to_user_id) ) latest on m.message_id = latest.max_id left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.user_id left join user tu on m.to_user_id = tu.user_id left join item i on m.item_id = i.item_id
and (fu.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tu.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or i.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by m.create_time desc

select m.message_id, m.item_id, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, fu.user_name as from_user_name, fu.avatar as from_user_avatar, tu.user_name as to_user_name, tu.avatar as to_user_avatar, i.title as item_title, (select count(*) from message x where x.item_id = m.item_id and x.to_user_id = #{userId} and x.from_user_id = if(m.from_user_id = #{userId}, m.to_user_id, m.from_user_id) and x.is_read = 0) as unread_count from message m join ( select max(message_id) as max_id from message where from_user_id = #{userId} or to_user_id = #{userId} group by item_id, if(from_user_id = #{userId}, to_user_id, from_user_id) ) latest on m.message_id = latest.max_id left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.user_id left join user tu on m.to_user_id = tu.user_id left join item i on m.item_id = i.item_id order by m.create_time desc

select m.message_id, m.item_id, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time, fu.user_name as from_user_name, fu.avatar as from_user_avatar, tu.user_name as to_user_name, tu.avatar as to_user_avatar from message m left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.user_id left join user tu on m.to_user_id = tu.user_id where m.item_id = #{itemId} and ((m.from_user_id = #{userId} and m.to_user_id = #{peerUserId}) or (m.from_user_id = #{peerUserId} and m.to_user_id = #{userId})) order by m.create_time asc, m.message_id asc
